verdict.rationale: Fellow's first-party MCP server lets users ask their AI assistant natural-language questions about meetings, such as "What were my action items this week?", with no code required. An "Ask Fellow" feature is also listed on the pricing page. The evidence shows natural-language querying, not natural-language commands that operate the product, such as creating or editing notes or completing action items. missing for 10: documented natural-language actions or commands (not just Q&A), in-product detail on Ask Fellow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
